notes.title: Demo Update 01
notes.content: [h1]We Updated the Demo![/h1][p]A bit delayed, but we published the first update for the demo today! [/p][p]It's a small download (roughly 150mb). [/p][p]Here's what's changed:[/p][list][*][p]Cut the amount of battery drained per second while using the flashlight in half. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where the Pause menu didn't function properly after interacting with the workbench[/p][/*][*][p]Added QoL tips for using interior lights when possible and that it's currently [i]expected[/i] for the wheel to freeze during the loading screen.[/p][/*][/list][p]These changes were made based upon player feedback. [b]Do keep the feedback coming[/b]! We'll continue to adjust the demo based upon your experiences and it'll also help us make the full game even better.[/p][h2]We appreciate you.[/h2][h3]Tell your friends about the game. We need your help getting the word out![/h3][p]Immortal, Inc.[/p][p](Justin)[/p]

notes.title: Cecil Hollow - Free Demo Available Now!
notes.content:
[h1]Cecil Hollow[/h1]
[h2]Free Demo Available Now![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197217/dff1ff8271695be9c4cd9ea1a524a270cf6fcff2.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Average Time to Completion: 30 - 60 minutes
[*] Genre: Adventure/Horror
[*] Number of Players: 1
[*] Platform: PC/Steam
[*] Can Players Stream/Record: Yes
[/list]

Cecil Hollow is an adventure horror game set on a remote Appalachian farm in which players are tasked with investigating anomalous phenomena. Could it be the result of aliens, paranormal activity, humans, or something else entirely? Experience this promising title for yourself by playing the new demo today! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197217/97e8b1cd24cae4bdefe61a39c1d6a6efb39c7e21.png[/img]

There has never been a more important time to learn about the UAP topic. The U.S. government has officially declared that UAP (AKA UFOs) are real. In the past two years, the U.S. Congress has had hearings featuring whistleblowers with explosive claims. There’ve also been “drone” incursions over U.S. Air Force bases in recent days and weeks with no explanation or identification. What are these things? And what does it all mean for humanity?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197217/3c5bf89bb7f732cba7a12fb84ed64f07373f2cec.png[/img]

The full game will feature more than one ending which will be determined by the player’s investigation and the release date is yet to be announced. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197217/443bd2eb4fa0a187cc14e90ee33138588f7136c9.png[/img]

Cecil Hollow is being developed by Immortal - a small startup studio based in Kentucky.

notes.title: Demo Playtest is live!
notes.content:
[h1]Calling all playtesters![/h1]

Limited access to the 1st Cecil Hollow demo playtest is now live! We're already seeing more interest than expected and wanted to make sure you all have everything you need to ensure a smooth and productive testing process.

[b]View important links and other testing info here:[/b]
- [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1LTHtH2BRqHBqzDQMoUdegdzZixYQxE7Nc08p_V-pdlg/edit?usp=sharing]Playtest Information[/url]

[b]Please complete this questionnaire about your experience:[/b]
- [url=https://forms.gle/s9kqPJMJtTj8qHWf8]Playtest Experience Questionnaire[/url]

If you need anything, please don't hesitate to reach out! Contact us through our Discord, X, Facebook, or e-mail. All respective links are on the game's page.

We appreciate you!
